A defined scope

Know what we
are building together.

Requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria are agreed for your project. The items below are topics to define during discovery, rather than a fixed package.

  • Requirements, scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria
  • Responsive interface design and review
  • Development of the agreed website, application, or integrations
  • Functional testing and checks against the agreed criteria
  • Release preparation, ownership handoff, and support scope

Common questions

Before we begin.

Should we start with a static website or a web application?

A static website is often suitable for service information and enquiries. Accounts, saved records, payments, or live business workflows usually need additional application services.

Can you improve an existing website?

Yes. We can review its content, usability, mobile layout, and technical constraints before proposing a scoped redesign or a smaller set of improvements.

How much will a project cost?

Cost depends on the requirements, integrations, content, and support scope. We discuss these first and prepare a proposal rather than giving an unsupported fixed price.
